name: Question 8
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,P\,$ | $\,R\,$ | $\,¬P⇔R\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-3}} |
worked_solution:
According to the definition of the biconditional, 

- $A⇔B$ is true if $A⇒B$ **and** $B⇒A.$ Otherwise, it is false.

- In other words, $A⇔B$ is true if $A$ and $B$ have the same truth values. Otherwise, it is false.

First, we add a column for $¬P:$

| $\,P\,$ | $\,R\,$ | $\,¬P\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Then, we add a column for $¬P⇔R.$ 

| $\,P\,$ | $\,R\,$ | $\,¬P\,$ | $\,¬P⇔R\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
